source: With Lucky in his shadow, his so‑far trusty sword at his side, and his repaired armor on him, Sam stepped out of the city, dodging the crowds that seemed to have swelled another size since he posted his stupid post and began heading towards his goal.
target: Cum Lucky in umbra eius, gladio fideli iuxta se, et armatura reparata induta, Sam e civitate egreditur, turbam vitans quae, postquam stultum nuntium suum edidit, quasi magis augebat, ac ad finem suum properabat.

source: Thankfully, dungeons weren’t a thing yet, so he knew he would have to fight the unknown monster out in the wild.
target: Gratias, speluncae nondum institutae erant, ideoque scivit se in regione agreste ignotum monstrum pugnare debere.

source: Which made things easier and at the same time harder.
target: Quod simul rem faciliorem et simul difficiliorem reddidit.

source: Understandably, dungeons made things easier because they were instanced content that somewhat scaled in difficulty to the number of people that entered them.
target: Intelligenter, speluncae rem faciliorem fecerunt, quoniam contenta erant singularia, quorum difficultas paulatim pro numero intrantium evoluta est.

source: And this instanced content ensured the security of the people who entered them.
target: Et haec contenta singularia securitatem intrantium confirmabant.

source: But with this came the danger.
target: Sed cum his periculum venit.

source: More powerful monsters, more traps and environmental hazards and so on.
target: Monstra potentiora, laqueos multiplices atque pericula ambientalia ceteraque.

source: While in the open world, monsters were easier to attack, ambush and defeat due to players being able to make use of the environment.
target: In mundo aperto, monstra facile oppugnari, insidiari atque vincere videbantur, quia lusores circumiecta uti poterant.

source: Yet, at the same time, this made it much harder to do it.
target: At eodem tempore, hoc idem facere multo difficilius faciebat.

source: Because if you could ambush the boss monster, other people could also ambush you.
target: Nam si poteras ducem monstrorum insidiari, alii te quoque insidiari poterant.

source: Or if you are very unlucky, then simply a party that was travelling by would spot you trying to fight the monster.
target: Aut, si valde infortunatus esses, pars itinerans te deprehenderet, quod monstrum pugnare conaris.

source: In the best‑case scenario, they would acknowledge your right to the monster and leave.
target: In optimo casu, ius tuum ad monstrum agnoscerent et discesserent.

source: In the worst, you would be fighting two battles at the same time.
target: In pessimo casu, bis simul pugnare deberes.

source: If you saw them coming…
target: Si eos advenientes videris…

source: As Sam walked along the road leading away from the town, once again wearing a different face thanks to his awesome mask, he couldn’t help but smirk, thinking about the chaos he caused with his post.
target: Dum Sam per viam discedentem e oppido ambulabat, iterum faciem aliam gestans propter mirabile larvam suam, non potuit impediri ridere, cogitans de tumultu quod post nuntium suum intulit.

source: The guilds around Ironwood and anywhere where trolls could be found were at each other’s throats, fighting tooth and nail to acquire the Life of Blood skill book.
target: Gildae circa Ironwood et ubique ubi troli inveni possent, inter se in acerrima contentionem erant, digito et unguie pugnantes, ut librum artium “Vitae Sanguinis” adipiscerentur.

source: It was such an amazing skill that everyone wanted it.
target: Ars tam mirabilis erat ut omnes eam optarent.

source: Which was a little deviation from his inherited memories.
target: Quod paulo a memoria eius hereditariis discrepabat.

source: In the future—that‑was the Life of Blood skill was famous, but it didn’t get such enormous fame as it did in his current timeline.
target: In futuro, ars “Vitae Sanguinis” nota facta est, sed non tanta fama acceperat quam in suo tempore praesenti.

source: Probably his post helped with it…
target: Forsitan nuntius eius id adiuvit…

source: His smirk turned into a chuckle at that thought.
target: Subridens eius in cachinnum conversa est ex illa cogitatione.

source: ‘Can’t wait until those two idiots figure out Blood Magic…’
target: ‘Non possum exspectare donec illi duo stulti Magiam Sanguinis cognoscant…’

source: While he walked, acting as if he was oblivious to the world, he was actually using all of his skills to make sure he wasn’t followed or there weren’t any random monsters or bandits hiding around.
target: Dum ambulabat, quasi mundo insensibilis, re vera omnes artes suas utebatur, ut neque sequeretur neque monstra temere aut latrones latearent.

source: His senses stretched as far as he could, feeling the mana in the air, in the forest and in the ground under him.
target: Sensus eius procul extendebantur, sentiens manam in aere, in silva et in solo sub eo.

source: His eyes were straining to see the smallest anomaly in the eccentric tapestry that the mana he saw was.
target: Oculi eius minimas anomalias in insueta textura manae visum intendebant.

source: His mana ticked up and down as he continuously used his skills, while the levels of Sam’s skills slowly but surely rose.
target: Mana eius ascendebat et descendebat dum constanter artes suas utebatur, dum gradus artium Sam paulatim sed certim augebantur.

source: After an hour on the road, whistling and seemingly traveling towards the next town over, he finally ascertained that nobody was on the road that seemed to be interested in him.
target: Post horam in via, sibilans et quasi ad proximam urbem iter faciens, tandem animadvertit neminem eum curare.

source: Granted the other travellers on the road, single people like him, a few merchant caravans, or lone carts drawn by all manner of beasts were there, but everybody was engrossed in their own lives.
target: Certe alii viatores—solitarii ut ipse, quaedam caravae mercatorum, aut sola plaustra a variis bestiis tracta—adfuerunt, sed omnes suis rebus occupati erant.

source: Even the players were more interested in talking about strategies and skill compositions or bragging about how many trolls they had already killed.
target: Etiam lusores magis interestabant de consiliis et compositione artium disputare aut se iactare de numero troli iam necatorum.

source: Nodding to himself, and spotting a rest station, which was basically a cleared part of the forest a few dozen yards away from the road proper, he slowly left the road and headed towards it.
target: Suam annuens et stationem requiei, quae fere areae purgatae silvae paucis passibus a via principali separata erat, animadvertens, viam relicuit atque ad eam se contulit.

source: He made a great show of stretching and groaning, despite not sensing anyone around there, but in case somebody was watching from the road, he wanted to make sure they only saw what he wanted them to see.
target: Magnam ostentationem faciebat extendens se et gemens, quamquam neminem illic sentiret, sed, ne quis ex via aspiceret, curare volebat ut solum ea viderent quae ipse videre voluerat.

source: ‘Probably wouldn’t fool a professional, but I’m not dealing with professionals… I hope…’ Sam thought as he glanced around.
target: ‘Forsitan peritum non falleret, sed non cum peritoribus nego… spero…’ Sam cogitavit dum circumspiciebat.

source: After all, it wasn’t paranoia if they were out to get you.
target: Postremo, non erat insania, si te persequi conabantur.

source: He spent a few minutes sitting on one of the logs that were in the rest station, drinking and snacking.
target: Paucis momentis in uno ex lignis in stazione requiei sedens, bibens et levis edulia capiens, tempus consumpsit.

source: Then, as he spotted a lull in the traffic on the road, and luckily a cloud hid the sun behind him, he stood up and softly exclaimed.
target: Tum, cum inter motum vehiculorum in via quietem animadvertit, atque feliciter nubes solem post se abscondebat, surrexit et leniter exclamavit.

source: “Shadow Cloak!”
target: “Pallium Umbrae!”

source: Instantly, his shadow shot up from under him, enveloping him and creating a sort of haze around him.
target: Statim, umbra eius ex eo emergit, eum involvens atque velut nebula circa eum formans.

source: At the same time, he jumped backward, then twisted in the air, and began running through the forest, away from the rest station and road.
target: Eodem tempore, retrorsum saltavit, in aere se torquens, ac per silvas currere coepit, a stazione requiei et via recessus.

source: He changed directions a few times, making sure to let the cooldown of Shadow Cloak go down, and restarting it every time he lost it.
target: Quoties directionem mutavit, curavit ut tempus refrigescendi Pallii Umbrae sequeretur, atque quotiens eam amitteret, iterum inciperet.

source: Finally, after running through the forest like a demented (but rather edgy) squirrel, he stopped in a clearing, breathing heavily, but grinning in happiness.
target: Denique, postquam per silvas quasi insanus sciurus cucurrit, in aperta area constituit, graviter spirans, sed laetitia subridens.

source: He always enjoyed playing ninja, and what he did was the same thing he did as a kid while playing around, but with superpowers.
target: Semper gaudebat ludere ut ninja, et quae agebat idem erant, quae puer ludens agebat, sed cum superviribus.

source: As Sam caught his breath, he took a quick glance at his notifications.
target: Dum Sam spiritum reciperabat, celerem aspectum in notis suis iecit.

source: He couldn’t help but be happy with what he saw.
target: Non potuit non gaudere ex iis quae vidit.

source: [Your skill, Multitasking has reached Level 25!]
target: [Ars tua, Multitasking, ad Gradum 25 pervenit!]

source: [Thanks to reaching level 25 with the Multitasking skill you gained Efficiency subskill!]
target: [Gratias ad artem Multitasking gradum 25 assecutus, subars “Efficientia” adeptus es!]

source: [Efficiency: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Everything you do through multitasking is much more efficient. Decreases mana consumption of spells when using them simultaneously and stamina when using physical skills simultaneously by 1%.]
target: [Efficientia: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passiva) Omne quod per multitasking facis efficacius est. Consumptio manae incantationum, cum simul adhibita, et stamina in artibus corporalibus simul usitata 1% minuitur.]

source: Efficiency was a rather common subskill, still, it was a rather good skill for his build, so Sam was happy with it.
target: Efficientia subars satis communis erat; sed pro structura eius optima arte videbatur, ergo Sam cum ea laetabatur.

source: [Your skill, Mage Sight has reached Level 6!]
target: [Ars tua, Mage Sight, ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

source: [Your skill, Mana Sense has reached Level 16!]
target: [Ars tua, Mana Sense, ad Gradum 16 pervenit!]

source: [Your skill, Discernment has reached Level 3!]
target: [Ars tua, Discernment, ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

source: [Your skill, Advanced Mana Control has reached Level 7!]
target: [Ars tua, Advanced Mana Control, ad Gradum 7 pervenit!]

source: Nodding in satisfaction, he took a last, deep breath, then took out a compass and map from his inventory and took a few seconds to orient himself, then took a few seconds to close his eyes and take a few deep breaths.
target: Satisfacto animo, annuens ultimum spiritum cepit, deinde ex inventario compassum et mappam extraxit, paucos secundos ad se orientandum sumens, deinde oculos clausit et aliquot profundos spiritus attulit.

source: Following that, he took out a simple black cloak, pulled it on, making sure that the hood of the cloak was covering his entire head, then turned on the Mana Shield and Shadow Cloak skills, covering himself head to toe, and with a final flex of his will, he ignited the Mana Body Enhancement skill and shot off towards his destination.
target: Postea, pallium nigrum simplex extraxit, induit, cavens ut caput totum operiret, deinde artes Mana Shield et Pallium Umbrae activavit, se a capite ad pedes tegens, atque ultimo studio voluntatis artem Mana Body Enhancement excitavit et in metam se coniecit.

source: He left behind a small clearing and a very surprised squirrel that fell out of the tree over him, as the sound of Sam’s departure managed to shock him.
target: Reliquit parvam claram aream et sciurum valde stupitum, qui e arbore super eum cecidit, quoniam sonitus discessus Sam eum perterruit.

source: Because the Chalice was hidden at a place that was also hidden from the general public, the old ranger couldn’t exactly give Sam directions straight to the area.
target: Quia calix in loco, qui a populo etiam abdito esset, celatus erat, senex custos silvarum Sam non potuit rectas instructiones ad locum dare.

source: Instead, Sam was given several landmarks to find and follow.
target: Proinde, Sam plurima signa itineraria invenire et sequi debebat.

source: The first landmark was a rather simple rock, called Candle rock by the people of the area, on the account of it looking like a melted candle.
target: Primum signum erat saxum simplicissimum, a incolis loci “Candle Rock” nominatum, quoniam ut candelam liquefactam videbatur.

source: It was on the border of the forest around Ironwood town and one of the mountains called (quite creatively) Ironspark Mountain.
target: In limine silvae circa oppidum Ironwood et in uno montium, qui ingeniose “Ironspark Mountain” vocabatur, erat.

source: It mostly contained iron and coal, with a few rarer metals here and there.
target: Imprimis ferrum et carbonem continebat, cum paucis metallicis rarioribus hic et illic.

source: So, nobody cared about it.
target: Ergo, neminem curabant id.

source: Until now.
target: Usque ad hoc.

source: Because recently a tribe of trolls had moved in.
target: Nam nuper tribus trollorum insediaverat.

source: And with them came the players.
target: Et cum eis lusores venerunt.

source: As Sam hid behind a tree thick enough that it would need at least four people to reach around it, he beheld a group of players apparently patrolling the area.
target: Dum Sam post arborem, tam crassam ut circumeundi quattuor homines opus esset, se abscondit, et coetum lusorum, qui loco peragrabantur, animadvertit.

source: Further up, he could hear the sound of battle.
target: Ulterius, sonitum proelii audire poterat.

source: Cursing to himself, he waited until the patrol moved further away, then after making sure his skills were turned on and Lucky wasn’t about to jump out of his shadow, he darted towards the next tree.
target: Se iurans, exspectavit donec custodia longius recesserat; tum, certus ne artes eius inactivae essent et Lucky e umbra eius exsilire pararet, ad arborem proxime festinavit.

source: Holding his breath, he watched the players for a clue they saw him, but they continued to walk away, carelessly talking about some kind of pop star.
target: Spiritum retinens, lusores intuens qua indicem haberent eum videre, sed illi ambulare pergebant, neglegenter de aliqua stella populari colloquentes.

source: Releasing his breath, he steeled himself and began darting from tree to tree toward his goal.
target: Spiritum dimittens, se firmavit et ab arbore una ad aliam, versus finem suum festinavit.

source: Soon, he found himself watching as a large group of people battling an equally large group of trolls.
target: Mox se invenit intuens coetum magnum hominum, qui aeque magnum tribum trollorum pugnabant.

source: But while the trolls were wielding wooden clubs and primitive stone axes, they were bombarded by steel‑tipped arrows, swords, spears, and all manner of other weapons, while a small collection of players, guarded by a few serious knight types, were lobbing fireballs and balls of electricity at the trolls.
target: Sed dum trolli baculis ligneis et rudimentariis securibus lapideis utebantur, telis ex ferro acuto, gladiis, hastis, et aliis armis oppugnabantur, et dum parvus coetus lusorum, a paucis gravibus equitibus custoditi, pilas ignis et electricitatis in trollos iaciebat.

source: While the spells looked rather anemic to Sam, and he winced every time he heard one of the mages cry out ‘Fireball!’, the players facing the trolls cheered whenever one of the spells hit the monsters.
target: Dum incantationes Sam paulo anemicae videbantur, et quotiens unus ex magis “Fireball!” exclamabat, lusores, qui trollos opponebant, exsultabant quoties incantatio in monstrum pertingebat.

source: He spent a few minutes just observing them and the trolls wanting to gather intelligence on the current average combat capability.
target: Paucis minutis eos et trollos observavit, scientiam de mediā pugnae potentia colligere cupiens.

source: Sam was getting ready to move, and he just waited for the Shadow Cloak to expire, while the group he was watching was celebrating a drop of the infamous skill book.
target: Sam se ad motum parabat, et exspectabat ut Pallium Umbrae exsuperaret, dum coetus quem spectabat lapsum libri artis infami celebrabat.

source: The skill expired, and he was no longer cloaked in shadows, staying absolutely still behind one of the trees he immediately renewed it and launched himself towards his next hiding spot.
target: Ars exspiravit, et non iam in umbris celatus erat; stans omnino quietus post arborem, eam statim renovavit et se ad proximam latebram projecit.

source: Sadly, it seemed his luck ran out.
target: Heu, videbatur fortuna eius exhaurita esse.

source: As he was midway between the two hiding spots, one of the people fighting the trolls cried out.
target: Dum inter duas latebras medium esset, unus ex hominibus qui contra trollos pugnabant exclamavit.

source: “There is someone here!”
target: “Hic aliquis adest!”

source: Instantly, the entire guild became tense, and different yells filled the air.
target: Statim, tota gilda anxia facta est, et diversas clamitates aerem repleverunt.

source: What?
target: Quid?

source: Who dares?
target: Quis audet?

source: Which guild wants our spoil?
target: Quae gilda spolia nostra appetit?

source: Thankfully, before they could properly react, he managed to reach his newest hiding spot.
target: Gratias Deo, antequam recte responderent, ad novam latebram suam pervenit.

source: He crouched down, ready to launch himself away, and listened carefully.
target: Se in genu flectit, paratus ad se proiciendi, et attente auscultavit.

source: “Are you sure?” spoke up one of the guys.
target: “Esne certus?” inquit unus ex iis.

source: Sam suspected the guild leader.
target: Sam ducem guildae suspicatus est.

source: “Yeah, boss! My skill pinged because it sensed somebody going by!”
target: “Ita, domine! Ars mea adnotavit, quia aliquem transeuntem sensit!”

source: Sam listened as the first man cursed up a storm, then asked another question.
target: Sam auscultavit, dum primus vir multa maledixit, deinde aliam quaestionem posuit.

source: “Where are they?”
target: “Ubi sunt?”

source: “Sorry, boss, I lost them instantly!”
target: “Ignosce, domine, eos statim amisi!”

source: Another curse session.
target: Alia sessio maledictorum fuit.

source: Then the man began to issue orders.
target: Deinde vir mandata dare coepit.

source: “Alright, if those assholes want to play with us, then we will play!”
target: “Ita, si illi impudentes nobiscum ludere volunt, tunc ludemus!”

source: Team one will stay here and continue farming.
target: Turma prima hic manebit et agros colligere pergat.

source: Team two I want you to be on guard!
target: Turma secunda, volo ut vigiletis!

source: Team three increase the patrol radius!
target: Turma tertia, augete spatium circuitus!

source: “Yes!”
target: “Ita!”

source: Sam smiled at their actions, relieved they only sensed him momentarily, he launched himself away from the tree he was hiding behind once again heading for the Candle rock, leaving behind an agitated guild.
target: Sam ob eorum facta subridens, contentus quod eum brevissime tantum perceptum esse videbantur, se iterum a arbore latebrantis proiecit et ad Candle Rock properavit, gilda turbata relicta.

source: Even if by accident, if he could stoke the flames of the developing guild wars, then Sam was happy.
target: Etiam, si casu, si pugnandas guildarum incursus excitare posset, Sam laetus esset.

source: Thankfully, there were no more interruptions on his way to the Candle rock.
target: Gratias Deo, nulla amplius interruptio in via ad Candle Rock erat.

source: He weaved through the trees, ignored every monster that looked his way, and another hour after leaving behind the guild farming trolls (thanking the stars that they had no idea that proximity wards were a thing) he arrived at a small outcropping holding the rock he was after.
target: Per arbores serpit, omne monstrum quod eum intueri conabatur neglexit, et post horam aliam, relicto coetu trollorum qui agriculturam exercebant (stellis gratias referens quod nesciebant munimenta proximitatis esse), ad parvum excrescentem locum, in quo saxum quaerebat, pervenit.

source: It jutted toward the sky, and upon Sam’s inspection, he had to agree it did look like a melted candle.
target: Saxum ad caelum protrudebat, et cum Sam inspiciebat, agnovit illud vere ut candelam liquefactam apparere.

source: If one squinted.
target: Si quis oculos constringeret.

source: But he wasn’t there to debate the naming sense of the locals.
target: Sed non adfuit ut de sensu nominandi incolarum disputaret.

source: He was here to hunt a monster down and get rid of the blood contract.
target: Hic adest ut monstrum venaret atque pactum sanguinis tolleret.

source: And of course, get all the sweet, sweet loot.
target: Et scilicet, omnem praedam dulcem ac delectabilem adipisci.

source: Slowly, Sam once again took out the map and compass, though after glancing at the compass, he put it back.
target: Lente, Sam iterum mappam et compassum extraxit, sed post aspectum compassi, id reponit.

source: Thanks to the iron in the mountains and some subtle enchantments that the ranger told him about, compasses were useless from this point forward.
target: Ob ferrum in montibus atque incantationes subtilissimas quas custos narraverat, compassi ab hoc tempore inutiles facti sunt.

source: He stepped next to the candle‑shaped rock and began looking around, trying to spot the landmarks he was told about.
target: Ad saxum, qui candelam formabat, accessit et circumspicere coepit, tentans signa itineraria, de quibus audiverat, deprehendere.

source: Finally, after a minute of straining his eyes, he spotted the first one.
target: Denique, post minutum oculis intendendo, primum signum animadvertit.

source: An ancient giant ironwood that was recognizable because it had two trunks heading toward the sky.
target: Antiquum ingens lignum ferreum, quod notabile erat, quoniam duo truncis ad caelum tendebant.

source: Then, after a few seconds, he spotted the other one.
target: Deinde, post pauca secunda, alterum animadvertit.

source: A distant waterfall that almost looked like a spot of bluish‑white dirt on the side of a mountain.
target: Cataracta remota, quae paene ut situs terrae caeruleo‑albae in latere montis videbatur.

source: His journey would take him between the two of them.
target: Iter eius inter ea duo pertransiturum erat.

source: Now that he found the proper directions, instead of continuing with his journey, he quickly set up a tent hidden between some rocks, let out Lucky, fed him, and played with him for a while, then he crawled into the tent, and simply logged out.
target: Iam directiones idoneas inveniens, pro itinere desinendo, celeriter tentorium inter saxa occultum posuit, Lucky dimisit, eum pascit atque aliquantum cum eo lusit, deinde in tentorium intravit et discessit.

source: He had been playing for a while; he had to take care of his biological function.
target: Aliquantulum lusit; necessarium fuit ut curam functionis suae biologicae ageret.

source: “Hopefully, with the bigger hype, they will announce the time restrictions earlier, because this is a murder on my sleep cycle…” Sam murmured as he ambled towards the bathroom.
target: “Spero, cum maiori strepitu, restrictiones temporales antea enuntiabuntur, quia hoc somnii mei interfectio est…” murmurat Sam, ambulans ad latrinam.

source: Finished with taking care of his annoying biological function Sam spent a few minutes checking the internet, watching almost in real‑time as the hype of the game continued to increase, while on the forums the Troll Wars as the players started calling it continued to escalate.
target: Perfecto curando functionem molestiorem biologicam, Sam paucos minutos in interrete explendo consumpsit, vix in tempore reali spectans quomodo fervor ludi augeret, dum in forum pugnae trollorum, ut lusores id nominare coeperunt, crescere perseverabant.

source: He logged back to find Lucky snuggled under one of his arms, snoring almost silently but looking absolutely content.
target: Rediit in ludum ut inveniret Lucky sub uno brachio eius collocatum, fere silentissime stertientem, sed omnino contentum videbatur.

source: Sam smiled and spent a few minutes just cuddling his wolf companion with the sinfully soft fur.
target: Sam subridens paucis minutis solum comitem lupum, cui pilus peccanter mollis erat, amplexus est.

source: “Duty calls, you silly boy,” he called out softly, poking the nose of the wolf.
target: “Officium vocat, puer ineptus,” inquit leniter, nasum lupī tussidens.

source: Lucky blinked a few times, then simply grinned at him and barked enthusiastically.
target: Lucky paucis oculis micavit, deinde simpliciter ei subridens latravit cum ardore.

source: “Good boy!” He petted the wolf, then extricated himself from the tent, followed by Lucky, who upon seeing Sam dismantling the tent, yawned, stretched a little, and simply jumped into his shadow.
target: “Bonus puer!” Fovit lupum, deinde se ex tentorio extraxit, secutus a Lucky, qui, cum Sam tentorium demolire videbat, oscitavit, paulo se extendit et in umbram eius saliit.

source: Which was followed by a single notification.
target: Quod sequitur una notificatio.

source: [Your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 8!]
target: [Ars tua, Spirit Link, ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

source: Sam chuckled a little, then threw another “Good boy!” at his shadow, then activated his skills and shot off towards his goal, keeping the unique ironwood tree and distant waterfall in his sight.
target: Sam paulo cachinnavit, deinde alium “Bonus puer!” ad umbram suam iacuit, postea artes suas activavit et in metam se coniecit, dum arborem unicam ligni ferrei et cataractam remotam in conspectu retinebat.

source: He had the next landmark to find.
target: Proximum signum inveniendum habebat.
